minor_issues.problem: Picture is still mostly metropolitan stations and designed shops; rural/local-line looseness is only implied.
minor_issues.suggestion: One clause that busy urban stations hold the densest marks; small shops may only have an informal front.

minor_issues.location: How Japanese People Experience Waiting — punctuality
minor_issues.problem: Dwell-time link is directionally right but can be read as queues alone keeping the timetable.
minor_issues.suggestion: Keep ‘one of the passenger-side tools’; soften ‘depends on.’ No invented seconds or on-time rates.

minor_issues.problem: Cleaning classrooms is editorial stitching, not how locals explain lining up; mild off-intent.
minor_issues.suggestion: Keep lunch lines and drills; drop or soften the sōji parallel.

minor_issues.location: Local waiting section — meiwaku; missing 整列乗車
minor_issues.problem: meiwaku gloss is narrower than local use; platform practice is unnamed.
minor_issues.suggestion: Gloss meiwaku as trouble imposed on others; optionally introduce seiretsu jōsha once.

minor_issues.location: ‘polite salon’; ‘the drawing just gets wet’; ‘Interpretation:’; ‘biological fact’
minor_issues.problem: A few clever or worksheet phrases break the magazine voice.
minor_issues.suggestion: Plain images; drop the Interpretation label; ‘Not by nature.’

minor_issues.problem: Same three lessons recur across body, scenarios, tips, and FAQ.
minor_issues.suggestion: One authoritative pass each; scenarios should add setting, not restated rules.
‘Busy city loop line’ or ‘packed urban platform.’

minor_issues.problem: Bag-width space can overteach gaps; airport line slightly flatters ‘locals comply.’
minor_issues.suggestion: Hedge spacing; treat confusion as layout, not nationality.

minor_issues.problem: Sibling wink more than a queuing need.
minor_issues.suggestion: Optional trim; dwell point stands alone.

final_summary: PASS. Queuing is framed as dense public infrastructure plus floor marks and low verbal negotiation, not a unique national soul. Disaster-orderliness stays hedged; cutting, sales chaos, and impatience are on the page. No critical or major issues; optional polish is urban/rural one-liners, a softer dwell-time verb, dropping the classroom-cleaning stitch, and a few English metaphors. Do not invent memoir or statistics.
title: Why Japanese People Queue So Carefully
